items.heading: Roasted Breadfruit and Fried Jackfish
details: Key ingredients: breadfruit, jackfish, lime, chili
Roast a whole breadfruit over an open flame until the skin chars.
Peel and slice the tender flesh.
Season and fry small jackfish until crisp.
Serve the fried fish alongside the roasted breadfruit.

items.heading: Callaloo Soup Vincentian
details: Key ingredients: dasheen leaves, coconut milk, crab, okra
Chop dasheen leaves and okra finely.
Simmer with coconut milk until soft.
Add crab for extra flavor and cook through.
Serve hot as a rich, creamy soup.
